description: This file contains TypeScript code for fetching and parsing HuggingFace models via an API, including caching mechanisms, data validation schemas, and utility functions for model data management.

methods.name: parseHuggingFaceModel
methods.description: Converts a HuggingFace model object into the application's ModelInfo format, considering optional provider-specific capabilities.

methods.name: getHuggingFaceModels
methods.description: Fetches available models from HuggingFace API with caching and validation.

methods.name: getCachedHuggingFaceModels
methods.description: Returns cached models without making an API request.

methods.name: getCachedRawHuggingFaceModels
methods.description: Returns cached raw models for UI display.

methods.name: getHuggingFaceModelsWithMetadata
methods.description: Fetches models with metadata, utilizing cache when possible.
